title: Tech Note: Optimizing Writing to the Cache with 4th Dimension

historical_commentary.text: This note's specific advice — tuned around Mac OS-era mechanical disk latency and 4D 2003's particular cache-flushing optimizations — reflects hardware and software conditions that have since been overtaken by SSD storage, vastly larger available RAM, and successive internal improvements to 4D's data engine and cache management across many subsequent versions. The general principle that cache sizing and disk write behavior affect 4D performance remains conceptually true, but the concrete recommendations here are dated enough to be of historical interest only rather than directly actionable guidance for current 4D deployments.
related_updates: Widespread adoption of SSD storage has fundamentally changed the disk I/O performance profile this note was optimizing for
4D's data engine and cache management have been revised multiple times in the two decades since this note, including changes accompanying the 4D v11 SQL engine (2007) and later releases
